speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you have hematuria and right flank pain; have these symptoms been present for days or weeks?  
Have you noticed any fever, chills, nausea, or visible blood clots in your urine?  
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis with microscopy and urine culture.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Urinalysis - Appearance: Reddish, WBC: 10-20 /HPF, RBC: Too numerous to count, Nitrites: Negative, Leukocyte_Esterase: Positive

speaker: Patient
text: 42-year-old Caucasian male. The patient reports experiencing visible blood in his urine accompanied by discomfort in his right flank. He denies any recent trauma to the area. He mentions a series of urinary tract infections over the past few years but has not been on renal dialysis.

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Hematuria and right flank pain. I also have History of recurrent urinary tract infections, No recent trauma.

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: No significant previous medical history except noted recurrent urinary tract infections. No history of renal dialysis or known genetic diseases. Social history: Non-smoker, drinks alcohol socially. Works in an office setting.

speaker: Patient
text: Denies fever, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, dysuria, or any recent illnesses. This is only for study purposes, so you do not need to list warnings or many alternatives. Please just provide the best final answer.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for clarifying; given the absence of fever or urinary symptoms, I need to know if you have a history of kidney stones or are taking blood thinners like aspirin. REQUEST TEST: Serum creatinine and electrolytes. REQUEST IMAGES: Renal Ultrasound.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Creatinine: 1.1 mg/dL; Electrolytes: Within normal limits; Renal Ultrasound: Multiple cysts present in the collecting ducts of the medulla. No obstruction noted.
